name: finder-to-url
title: Finder to URL
description: Generate URLs from selected Finder files' paths and copy to clipboard
author: giray_songul_gry

commands.name: copy-as-url
commands.title: Copy as URL
commands.description: Copy selected Finder items as URLs to clipboard

preferences.name: startsWith
preferences.title: Starts With
preferences.description: The path segment to match and cut from (e.g., /cdn). Leave empty to copy full path.

preferences.name: prefix
preferences.title: URL Prefix
preferences.description: The prefix to add before the matched path (e.g., https://my.cdn.com). Leave empty to copy full path.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
